body.p: 2. Amendments to the Claims: A listing of the entire set of pending claims (including amendments to the claims, if any) is submitted herewith per 37 CFR 1.121. This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application.

16. (Currently amended) A cavity determination An apparatus for determining a cavity within an object, the apparatus comprising:
[[-]] an introduction element a catheter for being introduced into the cavity, wherein the introduction elementcatheter is shape sensing enabled and comprises a bendable segment for being arranged within the cavity in different arrangements; and
[[-]] a computer including a non-transitory storage medium for storing instructions that, when executed by the computer, cause the computer curve determination device processor configured to:
determine a set of curves defined by the bendable segment using shape sensing information from the catheter, wherein each curve is defined by an introduction of the bendable segment within the cavity in a respective arrangement of the different arrangements, and wherein the determined set of curves comprises contact curves and non-contact curves, the contact curves and non contact curves not being distinguished from eash other by contact information; and
[[-]] a cavity reconstruction device processor configured to reconstruct the cavity in response to the determined set of curves.
17. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the cavity reconstruction device processor reconstructs instructions cause the computer to reconstruct the cavity using a regularization in response to the set of the determined curves and a morphological opening or closing of the set of the determined curves to estimate which points of the set of the determined curves lie necessarily within the cavity.
18. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the cavity reconstruction processor is instructions further configured cause the computer to determine whether one or more determined curves of the set of determined curves is a contact curve, and to reconstruct the cavity in response to the determined one or more contact curves.
19. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 16 further comprising a display device, operatively coupled to the cavity reconstruction device processorcomputer, configured to display a representation of the reconstructed cavity.
20. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the cavity reconstruction device processor is adapted to provide an adaptable cavity model and the instructions further cause the computer to adapt the an adaptable cavity model to the determined curves defined by the bendable segment in the different arrangements for reconstructing the cavity.
21. (Original) The apparatus of claim 20, wherein the cavity model is adapted to wrap determined curves that are not contact curves.
22. (Original) The apparatus of claim 20, wherein the adaptable cavity model is an anatomical model.
23. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the curve determination device processor is configured to determine the curves defined by the bendable segment within the cavity by shape sensing information comprises optical shape sensing information.
24. (Currently amended) A cavity determination method for determining a cavity within an object, the method comprising:
[[-]] determining non-contact curves defined by a bendable segment of an introduction elementcatheter introduced into the cavity in different arrangements within the cavity by a curve determination unit, using shape sensing information from the catheter; and
[[-]] reconstructing the cavity from the determined curves by a cavity reconstruction unit.
25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 24, further comprising:
adapting a cavity model to the determined curves defined by the bendable segment in the different arrangements for reconstructing the cavity
26. (Currently amended) A cavity determination non-transitory computer program readable medium that stores program code for determining a cavity within an object using a shape sensing enabled catheter for being introduced into the cavity, wherein the catheter comprises a bendable segment for being arranged within the cavity in different arrangements, wherein the computer program is characterized by non transitory program code means for causing a cavity determination apparatus as defined in claim 16 to carry out following steps, when the executed by computer program is run on a computer, the program code causes the computer to carry out steps including provided with one or more processor, for controlling the cavity determination apparatus:
determining, using the curve determination processor, a set of curves using shape sensing information from the catheter, each curve being defined by the bendable segment of the introduction elementcatheter introduced into the cavity in the respective arrangement of different arrangements within the cavity, the determined set of curves comprising contact curves and non-contact curves, the contact curves and non contact curves not being distinguished from eash other by contact information;
reconstructing using the cavity reconstruction processor, the cavity from the determined curves; and
displaying, on a display device operatively coupled to the cavity construction processorcomputer, a representation of the reconstructed cavity.
27. (New) The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 26, wherein the program code causes the computer to reconstruct the cavity using a regularization in response to the set of the determined curves and a morphological opening or closing of the set of the determined curves to estimate which points of the set of the determined curves lie necessarily within the cavity.
28. (New) The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 26, wherein the program code causes the computer to carry further steps including display a representation of the reconstructed cavity on a display.
29. (New) The apparatus of claim 26, wherein the program code causes the computer to carry further steps including adapting an adaptable cavity model to the determined curves defined by the bendable segment in the different arrangements for reconstructing the cavity.
30. (New) The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 29, wherein the cavity model is adapted to wrap determined curves that are not contact curves.
31. (New) The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 29, wherein the adaptable cavity model is an anatomical model.
32. (New) The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 26, wherein the shape sensing information comprises optical shape sensing information.
33. (New) The apparatus of claim 16, wherein the catheter comprises an ablation catheter, and wherein a distal tip of the ablation catheter is introduced into the cavity and the bendable segment is located at the distal tip.
